subject.title: fix(net-policy): preserve repeated secret query params

question: Should this PR preserve existing git plugin managed-repo cache identity while changing display redaction output, or may duplicate-secret git specs intentionally get new managed repo paths after upgrade?
rationale: The helper is shared by operator-facing display redaction and persisted git install identity, so accepting the output change without a compatibility path is an upgrade-risk decision.

options.title: Preserve cache identity before merge
options.body: Keep the display/log improvement, but use a stable non-display identity key or migration-backed compatibility path for existing git plugin installs.

options.title: Accept rare cache drift
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept that duplicate-secret git specs may re-clone or miss the existing managed repo path after upgrade.

options.title: Pause until proof and owner review
options.body: Hold the PR until the contributor supplies real behavior proof and a git-install owner reviews the compatibility impact.

recommendation.title: Preserve cache identity before merge
recommendation.body: Keep the display/log improvement, but use a stable non-display identity key or migration-backed compatibility path for existing git plugin installs.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved decision centers on git install managed-repo identity, and this person introduced the current git install behavior.
